title: aidd goal list --json
description: What `aidd goal list --json` prints: the shape of the work for a person. Each big goal (Initiative) and small goal (Epic, on the default branch) with where each of the person's decisions stands, each goal branch, and the trunk-based flow. The aidd pane draws it. A new optional key may be added in a minor release without a version bump; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

age_days.description: Days since its oldest commit the default branch lacks; 0 while it has none.

behind.description: Commits of the default branch it does not hold yet: `aidd sync` on it merges them in.

specs.description: The Specs that land in it (their `base`), and the ones it holds.

integrated.description: The Specs `aidd integrate` landed in it, read from the `Aidd-Integrate` trailers of its merge commits.

release_ready.description: At least one Spec is integrated, every other Spec that lands in it is finished, and it holds every commit of the default branch: the person's Merge approval releases it.

warnings.description: Past limits.max_goal_age_days, or behind the default branch: what to do about each.

goals.description: Each local goal branch (`goal/<name>`), the team's integration branch: what lands in it, what it holds, and whether it is ready to release. Absent with --branch, or when there is none.

branch.description: A local branch with work the default branch does not hold yet.

age_days.description: Days since its oldest own commit.

behind.description: Commits of the default branch it does not hold yet: `aidd sync` merges them in.

branches.description: The branches with unmerged work, goal branches aside, oldest first.

warnings.description: Past limits.max_open_branches or limits.max_branch_age_days: what to do about each.

flow.description: Trunk-based flow (DORA: three or fewer active branches, each merged at least daily): the branches with unmerged work and the warnings their count and age give. Absent with --branch, or when no branch holds unmerged work.

small_goals.description: The ids of its small goals (Epics) that are open.

initiatives.description: Each big goal on the default branch.

branch.description: Its goal branch when it is batched, else null.

status.description: Its derived status; `integrated` when its goal holds it, `planned` when nobody has started it.

specs.description: Its planned Specs, in landing order.

plan.description: D1: the Epic is on the default branch, so a person agreed to the plan holding it.

waits.description: The Spec ids (or the goal branch) waiting on a person for it now.

spec_approval.description: D2: the Specs past Spec approval.

waits.description: The Spec ids (or the goal branch) waiting on a person for it now.

release.description: D3: the Specs on the default branch (alone, dark), or the goal released (together, total 1).

state.description: Whether the launch is still ahead, waits on a person, or is done.

launch.description: D4, for a small goal that is flagged: its launch; null otherwise.

small_goals.description: Each open small goal on the default branch.
